title: When the Signal Burns
premise: Dominic Kavanagh, a former insurance investigator hiding in the freight lanes of contested space, discovers her own forged name on the manifest of the Meridian's Grace, a ship that officially never flew—and whose 'impossible accident' three years ago killed everyone aboard, including, on paper, her. The manifest is a keystone in an elaborate deception she helped build to prevent war between the Meridian Fleet and the Belt Compact, and someone is now unraveling it thread by thread. As Dominic races to find who resurrected the ghost ship's records, she must decide whether preserving the lie that holds two fleets apart is worth sacrificing the found family of misfits who have become her only home. In the end, she chooses truth over loyalty: she exposes the accident as sabotage by both sides' leadership, shattering the fragile peace but destroying the corrupt admirals who engineered it, and sails into uncertain exile with her crew—alive, finally, under her real name.
about_author: Yara Almeida is a former maritime insurance adjuster from Recife who traded flood claims for starship manifests after emigrating to Lisbon. Her fiction draws on a decade of reading between the lines of other people's disasters.

chapters.title: Dead Weight
chapters.summary: Dominic Kavanagh, hauling cargo through contested orbits under a false identity, takes a routine inspection job at Ceres Station. A customs clerk flags an anomaly: her name appears on a manifest for a ship that never flew. POV: Dominic. Beat: unease—the past knocking.

chapters.title: The Ship That Never Flew
chapters.summary: Dominic pulls archived records on the Meridian's Grace, destroyed three years ago in the 'accident' that ended the Border War. Her own signature is on the crew list. She realizes someone has weaponized her old forgery. POV: Dominic. Beat: cold dread.

chapters.title: Crew of the Long Haul
chapters.summary: Aboard her freighter, the Vela, we meet her found family: engineer Sefu, pilot Marisol, medic Oyelaran, and teenage stowaway Juno. Dominic hides the discovery, but Marisol notices her distraction. POV: Dominic. Beat: warmth shadowed by secrecy.

chapters.title: Paper Ghosts
chapters.summary: Dominic contacts her old handler, Quist, who built the false manifest as part of the armistice framework. Quist warns her: if the forgery surfaces publicly, both fleets will claim betrayal and war resumes. POV: Dominic. Beat: stakes crystallize.

chapters.title: Someone Is Reading
chapters.summary: The Vela's systems show a sophisticated intrusion attempt tracing the same archive queries. Someone else knows about the manifest and is hunting its author. POV: Sefu. Beat: paranoia enters the family home.

chapters.title: Three Years Invisible
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter: how Dominic, then investigator Kavanagh, uncovered that the Grace's destruction was staged, and how Quist recruited her into erasing herself to preserve the ceasefire. POV: Dominic (past). Beat: guilt established—she erased real victims' truth.

chapters.title: The Broker of Ashes
chapters.summary: A fixer named Ilse Varga offers to sell Dominic information about who leaked the manifest—for a favor owed later. Dominic refuses; Varga smiles like she already won. POV: Dominic. Beat: first antagonist contact.

chapters.title: Juno's Question
chapters.summary: Juno, researching war history for school, finds a memorial listing Grace crew—including a name matching Dominic's alias. She asks directly. Dominic lies badly. POV: Juno. Beat: fracture in trust within the family.

chapters.title: Meridian Waters
chapters.summary: The Vela docks at Meridian Fleet's hub for repairs. Dominic spots a Fleet intelligence officer photographing her ship. She realizes the hunt has institutional backing. POV: Marisol. Beat: the walls closing in.

chapters.title: Admiral Reyes
chapters.summary: Meridian Admiral Reyes, architect of the armistice, privately reviews the leaked manifest and orders Dominic found—not to protect the lie, but because the document implicates him too. POV: Reyes. Beat: villain revealed to reader.

chapters.title: Running Quiet
chapters.summary: Marisol confronts Dominic about the tail; Dominic confesses fragments—a fake name, an old case—but not the whole truth. The crew votes to run dark through Compact space. POV: Marisol. Beat: loyalty tested, partially granted.

chapters.title: Compact Corridors
chapters.summary: In Belt Compact territory, the crew meets smuggler allies who warn that Compact intelligence is also seeking 'the woman on the Grace manifest.' Both fleets are hunting her. POV: Sefu. Beat: no safe harbor anywhere.

chapters.title: What Oyelaran Knows
chapters.summary: Medic Oyelaran treats a wounded Compact defector who was part of the original cover-up team; he dies murmuring that the Grace carried something that had to disappear. POV: Oyelaran. Beat: mystery deepens beyond paperwork.

chapters.title: The Cargo That Wasn't
chapters.summary: Digging into the Grace's true cargo logs, Dominic learns it carried evidence of joint Fleet-Compact atrocities—evidence both governments wanted burned with the ship. POV: Dominic. Beat: the lie reframed as atrocity management.

chapters.title: Varga Calls In
chapters.summary: Ilse Varga activates her favor: she wants access to Quist. When Dominic refuses again, Varga leaks a partial manifest to a Meridian tabloid. Public questions begin. POV: Dominic. Beat: clock starts ticking loudly.

chapters.title: Quist's Confession
chapters.summary: Quist admits the cover-up went further than he told her: survivors of the Grace may still be alive, hidden in Compact custody as living proof neither side can afford. POV: Quist. Beat: hope kindled—truth might be survivable.

chapters.title: Ambush at Tycho Reach
chapters.summary: Fleet gunships corner the Vela in a mining corridor. A desperate slingshot escape costs them their cargo and nearly Juno, who freezes at her post. POV: Juno. Beat: terror; family bonds forged under fire.

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: In the quiet after the escape, Juno demands honesty. Dominic tells the crew everything: the forged manifest, the staged accident, her erased identity. Some forgive; Sefu walks out. POV: Dominic. Beat: lowest point—truth costs her the family.

chapters.title: Sefu's Choice
chapters.summary: Sefu, alone in a station bar, is approached by Fleet agents offering citizenship and safety for betraying Dominic's location. He takes the offer—or seems to. POV: Sefu. Beat: ambiguity, dread.

chapters.title: Reyes' Gambit
chapters.summary: Admiral Reyes plans to pin the entire cover-up on Dominic, turning her into the scapegoat that saves both fleets' leadership. He needs her captured alive. POV: Reyes. Beat: villain's design complete.

chapters.title: The Trap Springs
chapters.summary: Following a tip from 'Sefu,' Dominic walks into a sting at Ganymede. But Sefu double-crossed the agents—he's been feeding her location to Varga instead, who wants Quist. Chaos erupts. POV: Dominic. Betrayals layered on betrayals.

chapters.title: Varga's Price
chapters.summary: Captured by Varga, Dominic learns the broker serves a faction of Grace survivors' families who want the truth public regardless of war. Varga offers Dominic a choice: help expose everything or watch the crew die. POV: Dominic. Beat: impossible choice framed.

chapters.title: Marisol's Run
chapters.summary: Marisol and Oyelaran mount a rescue using every trick of the hauling life, while Juno hacks station traffic to blind security. POV: Marisol. Beat: the family fights back—loyalty answering truth.

chapters.title: Extraction
chapters.summary: The rescue succeeds messily; Varga escapes with a copy of the full manifest and Quist's location. Dominic realizes exposure is now inevitable—only its framing remains controllable. POV: Dominic. Beat: agency reclaimed.

chapters.title: Two Fleets, One Lie
chapters.summary: Both fleets mobilize over the leak. Reyes and his Compact counterpart, Director Anselm, secretly coordinate to contain it—revealing they've been partners all along. POV: Reyes. Beat: conspiracy's true shape shown.

chapters.title: The Survivors
chapters.summary: Following Quist's lead, the crew reaches the hidden Compact facility where eleven Grace survivors live in gilded captivity. Among them: Commander Ilsa Reyes—the admiral's daughter, listed dead. POV: Oyelaran. Beat: revelation that detonates everything.

chapters.title: Ilsa's Testimony
chapters.summary: Commander Reyes recounts the atrocity the Grace documented and how her father chose to burn the ship rather than the secret. She wants to testify; Dominic fears testimony means war. POV: Ilsa. Beat: truth vs. peace made flesh.

chapters.title: The Vote
chapters.summary: Dominic puts it to her crew: stay silent and keep the fragile peace, or broadcast the truth and risk everything. Juno argues for truth; Oyelaran for caution. They vote—barely—for truth. POV: Juno. Beat: collective moral commitment.

chapters.title: Preparations
chapters.summary: The crew plans a broadcast through the ancient relay array at the system's edge, needing parts, codes, and a diversion. Sefu returns, forgiven, with stolen Fleet encryption keys. POV: Sefu. Beat: reconciliation; family whole again.

chapters.title: Reyes Moves
chapters.summary: Admiral Reyes, learning his daughter lives, faces his own crisis—but chooses the lie, ordering the relay array destroyed and the survivors' facility 'sterilized.' POV: Reyes. Beat: corruption completes itself.

chapters.title: Race to the Edge
chapters.summary: The Vela runs for the relay with Fleet destroyers behind and Compact cutters ahead. Marisol flies a route no sane pilot would attempt through a debris field. POV: Marisol. Beat: pure velocity, held breath.

chapters.title: The Array
chapters.summary: At the relay, they find Fleet engineers already rigging demolition. A tense standoff; Oyelaran talks the engineers down by showing them the survivor list—some are their own kin. POV: Oyelaran. Beat: humanity over orders.

chapters.title: Broadcast
chapters.summary: Ilsa's testimony, the cargo logs, and Dominic's confession go out on every open channel. The lie holding two fleets apart burns away in minutes. POV: Dominic. Beat: climax begins—catharsis and terror together.

chapters.title: Anselm's Counterstrike
chapters.summary: Director Anselm attempts to seize the Vela and silence everyone permanently. Boarding action in the relay's corridors; Juno holds the transmitter alone against intruders. POV: Juno. Beat: climax peak—everything on the line.

chapters.title: What the Signal Carried
chapters.summary: The broadcast reaches fleet crews themselves. Enlisted sailors on both sides refuse orders to fire on the Vela; mutiny spreads through the ranks faster than command can suppress it. POV: multiple brief vignettes. Beat: power shifting to the people.

chapters.title: Reyes Falls
chapters.summary: Confronted by his own officers and Ilsa's voice on open comms, Admiral Reyes is arrested by his flagship's crew. Anselm flees Compact space, his network collapsing. POV: Ilsa. Beat: villains undone by truth.

chapters.title: After the Silence
chapters.summary: Weeks later: provisional tribunals convene. Dominic testifies, accepting consequences for her role in the cover-up, including her erased identity. The verdict suspends sentence in recognition of her disclosure. POV: Dominic. Beat: accountability without erasure.

chapters.title: Names
chapters.summary: The Grace's dead—and living—are formally restored to the record. The crew attends the memorial where Dominic, for the first time in years, signs her real name. Grief and release intermingle. POV: Dominic. Beat: mourning made honest.

chapters.title: New Manifest
chapters.summary: Peace talks begin, fragile but real, built on exposed truth rather than buried lies. Offers arrive for the Vela's crew—commissions, pardons, contracts. They weigh what visibility will cost. POV: Marisol. Beat: choosing a future.

chapters.title: When the Signal Burns
chapters.summary: The Vela departs under no flag, carrying relief cargo to the outer settlements. Dominic at the helm, her family around her, watches the relay's light fade astern. Invisible no longer—and no longer afraid of being seen. POV: Dominic. Beat: resolution—found family, chosen truth, open horizon.
